name: PrinceCon
blurb: A 46-hour tabletop role-playing marathon convention on Princeton University's campus, running annually since 1976.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'PrinceCon 50 will be held on March 5-7th 2027. Registration is not yet open.'

notes: PrinceCon is a student-run tabletop RPG marathon built around GM-written modules/scenarios rather than a media or celebrity guest program; the site has no 'guests' nav item or page of any kind, so guests is 'none' rather than 'none-yet'. PrinceCon 49 (March 6-8, 2026) already happened before the research window; PrinceCon 50 (March 5-7, 2027) is the next confirmed edition, with registration not yet open through the university's ticketing system. Organizer 'Simulation Games Union' is carried over from the batch note; nothing on the rendered homepage itself names an organizing body, so this is unverified.
